# Synthetic greenhouse guide

## Seed temperature
Basil seeds germinate best in this test greenhouse at 24 degrees Celsius. The tray stays shaded until seedlings appear.

## Watering
The orchid bench is watered every six days. Standing water must drain before the evening inspection.

## Light
Tomato seedlings receive fourteen hours of light daily. Lamps remain off during the ten-hour night interval.

## Feed
The hydroponic test tank uses nutrient mix NPK-712 at a dilution of 1:800. It is unrelated to travel reimbursement.
